## What this commits you to

Nothing on a schedule. Concretely:

- reviewing pull requests that touch your area — there are not many
- having an opinion when a design decision affects it

You do **not** need to know the rest of the ecosystem, and you can stop whenever
you like — we will say so gracefully in `MAINTAINERS.md`.

A short yes is enough.
